description: Share the session you are in right now with the team. Write the summary yourself from the conversation: it is what teammates read first. Never include secrets.

continues.description: Id of the shared session this work continues. Defaults to the one loaded with get_session in this repo; "none" to unlink.

done.description: What was finished in this session

for.description: Name or email of the teammate this handoff is for

goal.description: What this session is trying to achieve

hide_prompts.description: Leave the user's typed prompts out (a marker takes their place); your replies and tool steps are kept. Pass true when the user asks to share without their messages. Defaults to the user's setting (relay config prompts)

ignore_template.description: Share even if the repo's template has required sections you left empty

include.description: What to upload besides your summary: nothing, the last 30 messages, or the whole transcript. Default "summary+tail"

include_diff.description: Attach the uncommitted changes in this repo (redacted), so the next person gets the exact code state

next.description: Concrete next steps for whoever continues

open_questions.description: Unresolved questions the next person should know about

people.description: Names or emails who can see it; omit for the whole team

pr_url.description: Pull request URL. Defaults to the current branch's open PR (via gh); "none" to leave out

sections.description: Extra sections, e.g. the ones share_template asks for

title.description: Short title; defaults to the first prompt (or the goal, when the user's prompts are left out)

name: share_current_session
title: Share this session
